# Feature: Species template gender model preview

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-20 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
When avatar source is „Vorlage anpassen“, selecting a species template (Mensch) plus Geschlecht (männlich/weiblich) shows the matching first-party GLB in the sheet `AvatarSurfaceViewer`. Divers (and unset gender) shows no 3D model. Other species stay without models until authored.

## Preconditions
- Pilot GLBs exist at `/assets/avatars/species/human-male.glb` and `human-female.glb`
- Character Editor open, avatar source `sagadrive`
- WebGL available in the browser

## Happy Path
- [ ] Choose Vorlage anpassen → Mensch → Geschlecht männlich → left viewer loads `human-male.glb` (WebGL, not „CH“ initials)
- [ ] Switch Geschlecht to weiblich → viewer loads `human-female.glb`
- [ ] Switch Geschlecht to divers → no model URL; portrait/initials fallback (no invented mesh)
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict / Boy Scout)
- [ ] Deterministic check script PASS

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Gender unset → no template model (same as divers for mesh)
- [ ] Non-human template (Elf, …) → no template model yet (fail closed)
- [ ] Import / Meshy generate sources still own their own model_url; template resolver does not override importedModelUrl
- [ ] Only allowlisted relative `/assets/avatars/species/*.glb` paths (no free client URLs)

## Regression
- [ ] Species carousel / sheet save still persist `gender_reading`
- [ ] Meshy busy overlay still replaces viewer while generating

## Assumptions
- Default preview uses male/female pilot assets only for `human`; divers has no mesh by product choice
- Catalog `fantasy-human` remote fallback unchanged this ticket (self-hosted public assets via relative URL)

- Domain: `species-template-models-v1.ts` — allowlisted `/assets/avatars/species/{human-male|human-female}.glb`

- Editor passes `genderReading` into the hook
